# MERA Auto-Generated Code (Fall Detection)

This directory contains C source code auto-generated by the RUHMI (MERA) Framework
for the fall/person detection model (INT8) targeting the Ethos-U55 NPU.

Generated with **RUHMI Framework MERA 2.6.0+pkg.4513** using the unified
`mcu_compile.py` script (`--npu --ref-data --suffix _net1`).

## How to generate

```powershell
# RUHMI Framework (MERA 2.6.0+) の仮想環境をアクティベートした状態で実行
cd C:\work\ruhmi-framework-mcu
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
C:\Users\grace\github\mimamori-sense\scripts\deploy_fall_detection.ps1
```

See `doc/analysis_report/f003_04_mera_conversion_guide.md` for details.

## Source model

- `dataset/models/yolo_fastest_person_darknet_int8.tflite` (192x192, INT8)
  - `scripts/deploy_fall_detection.ps1` の `$ModelSrc` が変換対象モデルの正
